units.source_text: 同学们都觉得难以置信。

en.t: All the classmates found it hard to believe.

units.source_text: 在难以置信的情绪里，也有一种莫名的欢乐的情绪，还有一种和以前完全不一样的嫉妒心情。

en.t: Within their disbelief there was also a strange feeling of joy, and a jealousy completely unlike anything they had felt before.

units.source_text: 有的人相信信子，认为她是不得不听从母亲的安排。

en.t: Some believed Nobuko and thought she had no choice but to follow her mother's arrangement.

units.source_text: 有的人怀疑信子，认为她是变了心。

en.t: Others doubted Nobuko and thought she had changed her mind.

units.source_text: 但无论如何，这些即使都是猜测，她们自己也非常清楚。

en.t: But in any case, even if all of this was only guesswork, they themselves understood it very well.

units.source_text: 信子为什么没有嫁给俊吉？

en.t: Why had Nobuko not married Shunkichi?

units.source_text: 在那之后，她们经常讨论这个问题。

en.t: After that, they often discussed the question.

units.source_text: 就这样过了俩月，她们就忘了信子这个人，当然也忘了信子想要成为小说作者这件事。

en.t: In this way two months passed, and they forgot Nobuko herself; naturally, they also forgot that she had wanted to become a novelist.
